name: Jonathan P. How
title: Ford Professor of Engineering; Director, Aerospace Controls Laboratory
fitReason: Direct overlap between machine learning, uncertainty-aware control and deployed ground/aerial robotics. TRAIL couples learned terrain representation with executable trajectory optimization.

physicalEvidence.summary: TRAIL, revised February 27, 2026 and listed by ACL as RA-L 2026, runs learned camera/LiDAR terrain estimation and planning on an AgileX Scout Mini with ZED 2i and Ouster OS1-32. Training uses Clearpath Husky A300 data. Section V separately reports physical short-route tests and a roughly 370-meter field route; simulation-only diagnostic studies are explicitly separate. The paper has MIT authors and is listed by How’s current lab. No exclusive equipment ownership is inferred.
